message.reasoning_content:
We need to solve: Ashley has internet speed 20 kilobytes per second. 1 megabyte = 1000 kilobytes. Find speed in megabytes per hour.

First convert 20 KB/s to MB per hour.

20 KB/s = 20/1000 MB/s = 0.02 MB/s.

Now per hour: 1 hour = 3600 seconds. So MB per hour = 0.02 * 3600 = 72 MB.

Thus answer 72.

We need output format:

ANSWER: <one short sentence in Arabic>
FINAL: <answer>

Make sure FINAL is just number: 72.

Proceed.
